description:
Subject: Incident Assignment – Pingdom Check #12345

Dear Team,

An incident has been assigned to the on‑call engineer. The incident ID is **987654321**, originating from the Pingdom check **12345** titled **“Website HTTP Check.”** This check monitors the host **api.example.com**, and the assignment was triggered because the response time threshold was breached. The full description of the event reads: “Incident assigned to on‑call engineer due to response time threshold breach.” Please investigate the issue at your earliest convenience.
